_note: Beta channel manifest — same shape as stable.json. Placeholder values until the first beta is cut.

access._note: The engine license gate (worker/: the download gate Worker). install.sh records each acceptance of engine.eula with api (POST <api>/accept; a later run, POST <api>/token) and sends the token it returns with every download whose URL starts with one of gated: the engine's files and its models, which live in a private bucket only the Worker reads. Everything else here downloads without one: the license text, the brain package, and the engine's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt (under dl/notices/, public on purpose). manifest/check.py downloads the gated files with DL_CHECK_TOKEN.

g2p_dict._note: en-us G2P lexicon (teagram-engine engine/g2p/kokoro_g2p.v2.dict). GENERATED FROM the misaki en-US gold/silver lexicons (Apache-2.0, hexgrad and the misaki contributors, https://github.com/hexgrad/misaki) by teagram-engine tools/g2p_dict_convert.py, which flattens POS entries to DEFAULT and merges silver under gold — a derivative work, not a file copied from misaki. Attribution ships in the engine's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. MUST install to bin/g2p/ — without it the engine silently degrades to espeak-only G2P and prosody goes robotic (2026-08-05). Arch-independent; rides the engine release.

pos_model._note: engine/g2p/kokoro_pos.bin: averaged-perceptron part-of-speech tagger distilled from spaCy en_core_web_sm tags, so the G2P can pick misaki's POS-keyed homograph readings (read/lead/live/...). Training sources and licenses are in the engine's NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. MUST install to bin/g2p/ beside the dict — without it homographs read in their default form. Arch-independent; rides the engine release.

notices._note: engine/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt from the commit the engine binary above was built from. Carries the MIT/BSD/Apache-2.0 attributions for the engine's third-party components. install.sh installs it to $PREFIX/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt; re-cut with every engine release.
